blueprints.projectTitle: Makkani Nexus-Treasury: Global Autonomous Supply-Chain & FinTech ERP SaaS
blueprints.industry: Cross-Border FinTech, Autonomous Logistics & Multi-Enterprise ERP SaaS
blueprints.architectureStack: FastAPI (Async Python), Rust Core (Risk Engine), Next.js 14 App Router (React/Tailwind), CockroachDB (Distributed SQL), Redis Cluster, Kafka Event Bus, Docker Swarm / K8s
databaseSchemaTables: enterprise_tenants (id, tenant_name, base_currency, compliance_tier, api_keys_vault, created_at)
multi_currency_treasury (treasury_id, tenant_id, asset_type, balance, locked_funds, fx_hedging_reserve)
cross_border_ledger (transaction_id, sender_tenant, receiver_tenant, swift_iso20022_payload, settlement_status, gas_fee)
global_shipments (tracking_uuid, carrier_id, current_geo, waybill_docs, iot_telemetry, customs_status, eta_timestamp)
blueprints.deepReasoningDesignNotes: Is architecture mein distributed atomic multi-currency settlements ko CockroachDB ke Raft consensus se lock kiya gaya hai taake zero double-spending aur ultra-low latency FX swaps facilitate ho sakein. Event-driven Kafka stream directly enterprise supply chain telemetry ko treasury liquidity se sync karti hai, automatically triggering invoices aur customs clearance without human intervention.
blueprints.deploymentStrategy: Autonomous multi-cloud rollout across AWS us-east-1 and Frankfurt edge nodes via Terraform, encrypted at-rest using HashiCorp Vault HSM, protected by Cloudflare Magic Transit and zero-trust mTLS service mesh.
